# Map (`map`)

Map controls and compass.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMap` (types in `dist/web/media/map.d.ts`): `mountMap` on a new `<div>`.

```ts
export function createMap(options: MapOptions): MapHandle;

export interface MapOptions {
  /** Accessible name ("Map of the garden"). */
  label: string;
  /** Where tiles come from; without one the map draws a plain grid and says so. */
  tiles?: MapTileSource | null;
  /** Tile edge in pixels (default 256). */
  tileSize?: number;
  /** Zoom levels the tile source has (default 0 to 19); past the top, tiles are scaled up. */
  tileMinZoom?: number;
  tileMaxZoom?: number;
  /** Credit the tile source asks for, shown in the corner. */
  attribution?: string | null;
  /** Starting view; without `center` the view fits the markers. */
  center?: { lat: number; lon: number } | null;
  zoom?: number;
  bearing?: number;
  minZoom?: number;
  maxZoom?: number;
  markers?: readonly MapMarker[];
  /** Zoom and recentre buttons (default true). */
  controls?: boolean;
  /** The compass (default true). */
  compass?: boolean;
  /** Scale bar (default true). */
  scale?: boolean;
  /** Two-finger twist and Shift + arrows turn the map (default true). */
  rotate?: boolean;
  /** Width / height (default 16 / 10). */
  aspect?: number;
  labels?: Partial<MapLabels>;
  onViewChange?: (view: MapView) => void;
  /** Makes markers buttons. */
  onMarkerSelect?: (marker: MapMarker, index: number) => void;
}

export interface MapHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getView(): MapView;
  setView(view: Partial<MapView>): void;
  setMarkers(markers: readonly MapMarker[]): void;
  setTiles(tiles: MapTileSource | null, attribution?: string | null): void;
  zoomBy(delta: number): void;
  /** Fits the markers (or goes back to the starting view). */
  recentre(): void;
  /** Re-measures the frame (it also follows resizes by itself where ResizeObserver exists). */
  layout(): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface MapLabels {
  zoomIn: string;
  zoomOut: string;
  recentre: string;
  compass: (bearing: number) => string;
  hint: string;
  noTiles: string;
  roleDescription: string;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMap, createText, type MapMarker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const places: MapMarker[] = [
  { lat: 51.0004, lon: 7.0012, label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { lat: 51.0042, lon: 7.0091, label: 'Workshop', tone: 'neutral' },
  { lat: 50.9968, lon: 7.0108, label: 'Pier' },
];

const status = createText('Select a place.', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const map = createMap({
  label: 'Around the house',
  // Your tile server's XYZ template and the credit it asks for.
  tiles: 'https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png',
  attribution: '© Example Maps',
  markers: places,
  onMarkerSelect: (place) => {
    status.textContent = `${place.label ?? 'Place'} selected`;
    map.setView({ lat: place.lat, lon: place.lon });
  },
});

document.body.append(map.el, status);
```

`TileMap` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Builds `mountMap` into a `<div>` it renders; same DOM and classes once mounted. The view props set the startingview (and move it when they change); `markers`, `tiles` and `attribution` update in place.

```ts
export function TileMap({ label, tiles = null, attribution = null, markers = [], center, zoom, bearing, className, onViewChange, onMarkerSelect, ...setup }: MapProps);

export interface MapProps {
  label: string;
  tiles?: MapTileSource | null;
  tileSize?: number;
  tileMinZoom?: number;
  tileMaxZoom?: number;
  attribution?: string | null;
  center?: { lat: number; lon: number } | null;

  controls?: boolean;
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Text, TileMap } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MapMarker } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const PLACES: MapMarker[] = [
  { lat: 51.0004, lon: 7.0012, label: 'Home', icon: 'home' },
  { lat: 51.0042, lon: 7.0091, label: 'Workshop', tone: 'neutral' },
  { lat: 50.9968, lon: 7.0108, label: 'Pier' },
];

export function MapExample() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<MapMarker | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <TileMap
        label="Around the house"
        // Your tile server's XYZ template and the credit it asks for.
        tiles="https://tiles.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
        attribution="© Example Maps"
        markers={PLACES}
        center={selected}
        onMarkerSelect={setSelected}
      />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {selected ? `${selected.label ?? 'Place'} selected` : 'Select a place.'}
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
